gitCommit.subject: fix: repair sessions→sort→results workflow (purses-r7p) (#208)
gitCommit.body:
fix: repair sessions→sort→results workflow (purses-r7p) (#208)

* docs(spec): sort-flow repair design (canonical TDD)

Consolidate the SortResult lifecycle on SortResultService (Architect decision);
repair the inert session-detail results trigger + delete dead SessionCompleteScreen
(UX decision); add repo delete(); canonical Red-Green-Refactor per behavior,
promoting each it.fails tripwire as it goes green. Tests verify BOTH triage and
compare decisions reach a populated result. Out of scope: listShares/xca/o93/start-form.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): rev-2 — fold spec-review BLOCK + acceptance criteria

Acceptance: 0 it.fails (all tripwires fixed+promoted), avoid mocking (un-mocked
integration/e2e proof), all tests pass, app works in Playwright e2e. Scope
expands to every tripwire (listShares/xca/start-form). Resolutions: supersede
keeps finalized-only guard (else 409); deleteResult does explicit transactional
child-delete (schema has NO FK cascade) + zero-orphan integration assertion +
hard-delete justified (derived state) + draft-only 409; canonical-owner claim
scoped to create/supersede/delete (working get/patch/finalize stay); pairwise
proven by rank-order within a shared tier.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): rev-3 — fold re-review (deleteResult no-txn children-first; route 404/409 mapping; rank direction; start-form product decision)

Resolves the Data BLOCK by relaxing the unimplementable atomicity promise to a
children-first ordered delete (codebase has no transactions; single-curator
draft delete is FK-safe + recoverable). Adds the required route status-mapping
(null->404, status-guard->409, replacing the current ->500); pins the pairwise
rank assertion direction (winner.computedRank < loser.computedRank); makes the
start-form->triage landing an explicit product decision.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(plan): sort-flow repair — 8 TDD tasks, un-mocked proof, 0-it.fails gate

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): materialize result items on POST /api/sort-results (purses-r7p)

* fix(sort): supersede clones a finalized result into a new draft (409 otherwise)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): deleteResult removes a draft and its items, children-first (409 if finalized)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): deleteResultItem removes a single result item

DELETE /api/sort-results/[id]/items/[rid] was a no-op stub: it returned
200 while the row survived. Wire it to SortResultService.deleteResultItem
-> ISortResultItemRepository.delete(rid), preserving requireApiResultAccess
and the belongs-to-parent guard (404 when item.sortResultId !== id).

Remove the dead ResultItemController.deleteResultItem stub (no callers).

Tests (RED-first): promote the unit DELETE tripwire to assert the row is
gone, and add an un-mocked DB integration test driving the real route that
proves the targeted item is removed while the others remain.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): scope listShares to the result via findByResult

GET /api/sort-results/[id]/shares returned a hardcoded [] (unscoped
TODO stub). Change ShareController.listShares() -> listShares(resultId)
to call shareRepo.findByResult(resultId), and pass params.id from the
route GET. Promote the quarantined tripwire to a live test asserting the
created share for the result appears in the response, and add an
un-mocked DB integration test proving the list is scoped to the result.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): low tier reads 'Onward' not 'Release' (purses-xca)

Tone contract requires affirmation framing, not letting-go. Relabel
every user-facing low-tier 'Release' label to 'Onward':
- ItemCard bucketLabels.low (badge title rendered on results)
- sort session bucket-count grid
- triage decision button
- session-complete bucket-count grid
Internal bucket key stays 'low'. Promotes the purses-xca results-page
tripwire from it.fails to a live regression guard, and updates the
DecisionControls test fixture to match the new triage label.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): start session lands directly on triage

After POST /api/sessions, StartSessionForm now router.push()es straight to
/sort/{number}/triage instead of the session-detail page. The detail page
stays reachable via the breadcrumb. Promote the quarantined e2e fixme into the
landing test (folded with the conflicting detail-landing assertion so there is
one landing contract), and update the StartSessionForm unit test to the triage
push target.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): reachable 'See what you love most' trigger creates a populated result; remove dead SessionCompleteScreen

Replace the inert 'Ready to see results?' card (which linked to the results
LIST and created nothing) with SeeResultsCard, a client trigger that POSTs
/api/sort-results to materialize a populated draft result and navigates to it.
On failure it shows a soft, reversible message and re-enables — nothing lost.

Delete the dead SessionCompleteScreen (+ test): no route mounted it.

Add an end-to-end journey e2e (triage a decision -> compare a pair -> the
trigger creates a populated result and lands on it) and an error-state test
(route-intercept 500 -> soft message, button re-enables, stays on session).

purses-ais: rename the stale 'Release' triage-button assertion to 'Onward' and
fix the now-stale low-tier comment in the e2e seed fixture.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses): re-enable triage tiers after a successful decision (U2)

DecisionControls reset pendingLabel only on the error path. On a
successful save it called router.refresh() (or onDecisionMade) but left
pendingLabel set. The triage page mounts DecisionControls with no
per-item key, so the client instance + its pendingLabel survive the soft
router.refresh() to the next item — keeping every tier disabled
(disabled={pendingLabel !== null}) and one button stuck on "Saving...".
A normal user could not triage past the first item.

Fix: reset pendingLabel on the success path so the controls re-enable
for the next item. The error path is unchanged; CompareChoice is a
separate component and is unaffected.

Tests:
- DecisionControls.test.tsx: regression test proving the tiers
  re-enable after a successful save on the router.refresh() path.
- e2e/sort-session.spec.ts: the journey test now triages TWO items
  consecutively (tap item 1 -> assert advance + tiers re-enabled -> tap
  item 2 -> 2 of 2), an honest multi-item demonstration that a user can
  actually sort.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(test): refresh stale POST tripwire comment (now wired + passing)

* docs(api): sync sort-results route behaviors (materialize/supersede/delete/shares) — purses-u3p

* chore(graphify): refresh graph for sort-flow repair

* docs(arch): note draft sort-result hard-delete (children-first, no FK cascade) — purses-r7p

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
